extension.description: Stremio for Kodi program addon with embedded Nimbus Home and media information. Nimbus layouts and artwork by Ivar Brandt. Kodi remains the playback engine; the global Kodi skin is unchanged.
extension.news: 1.0.42: Inline theme-coloured stream panel with reversible flip transitions; readable episode cards and fully visible last episode; rounded controls, compact icon sidebar and country-based weather; configurable cache lifetimes and limits; manual bug/feature reports and last-error retry; private addon configuration QR with explicit sync; stronger account saves and launch recovery; Dark Cinematic branding, previews and optional live developer support. Native Stremio watch-progress write-back is not included.
